forbidden.title: You don't have permission to view this.
forbidden.explanation: Generating a month's fees is limited to administrators and accountants.

year.label: Academic year
year.hint: Fees are generated from the fee structures defined for this academic year.

scope.hint: Leave both on "All" to run the whole school for this academic year.

period.outsideYear: {{month}} {{year}} is outside {{name}} ({{start}} to {{end}}). Choose a month inside the academic year, or go back and choose a different year.

review.heading: Check this before generating
review.countFailed: The student count couldn't be loaded. You can still generate — the count is only a preview.
review.count_one: {{count}} active student is in scope and will be evaluated.
review.count_other: {{count}} active students are in scope and will be evaluated.
review.estimateNote: That is how many students will be looked at, not how many fee records will be created. A student with no fee structure that applies this month gets nothing, and a student who already has a fee for this month is skipped.

result.title: Fee generation finished
result.skippedExplainer: Skipped means a fee record already exists for that student and month — re-running is safe and will skip everything already generated.
result.nothingGenerated: Nothing new was created this time. Everything in scope already had a fee record for this month.

errors.rateLimited: Fee generation is limited to 5 runs per minute — wait a moment and try again.
errors.unknown: We couldn't confirm the result of this run. Re-running is safe — anything already created will be skipped.
